2. The short facts relevant for disposal of this rule am that, the opposite party as plaintiff instituted a suit being Other Class Suit No. 120 of 2005 before the learned Assistant Judge. Sadar, Natore for partition. The said suit was subsequently decreed on the basis o a solenama against the defendant Nos.1-24, 42, 72 and ex-parte against the defendant No. 94-petitioner and others by judgment and decree dated 22.3.2006 (decree signed on 24.3.2006). In this background of the case the present defendant No.27-petitioner filed Misc. Case No.27 2006 before the learned Assistant Judge, Sadar, Natore under Order 9, Rule 13 the Code of Civil Procedure for setting aside the judgment and decree dated 22.3.2006 on the ground that no summon was properly served upon him. 

 8. Mr. Gazi Md. Gias Uddin Ahmed, the learned Advocate appearing for the opposite party, on the other hand opposes the Rule. He submits that the petitioner was all along aware of the present suit and the suit was decreed' on 22.3.2006 (decree signed on 24.3.2006) on the basis of solenama within the full knowledge of the defendant No.27-petitioner, who in the said sola decree got his proper saham. He further submits t--hat both the Courts below after a detailed discussion of the attending circumstances borne out by records rightly held that the summon was properly served upon the defendant No.2.1-petitioner and as such question of interference does not arise at all.
